summary.text: Maharashtra won by 10 wkts after restricting BEN to 143-10 and 186-10 while scoring 218-10 and 114-0 in reply. Tanay Sanghvi took 4 for 30 and scored 60 off 179 balls for Maharashtra, while Mohammed Shami claimed 4 for 37 for BEN. Abishek Porel (wk) top-scored for BEN in both innings with 54 off 67 balls and 65 off 84 balls, and Sachin Dhas led Maharashtra's second innings with 61 off 68 balls alongside Pradeep Dadhe's 4 for 48.
